description:
Peerless Skills - Renewed

WHAT DOES THIS MOD DO?
A third level past Elite for your fourteen combat skills: Peerless.
You buy it with Peerless skill points on the Second-in-Command Character screen (C).

Requires LunaLib, LazyLib, PatchLib and Second-in-Command.

Screenshots

Peerless Skill Points
The Character screen shows "Peerless skill points" under your level.
Click an Elite combat skill, then Save: it becomes Peerless and gets a gold diamond. Each costs one point.
Click a Peerless skill to undo it and get the point back.
Every combat skill tooltip has a Peerless part after Elite.

Where Points Come From
With Achievements - Renewed: big achievements pay a point each, once per campaign. A campaign that does everything earns enough for all fourteen skills; a normal one earns 1 to 4.
Without it, or if you choose: every few full experience bars past the level cap make a point.
A LunaLib setting speeds up or slows down how fast points come.

Effects
Helmsmanship: accelerating backwards is twice as fast.
Combat Endurance: once per battle, at 10% hull the hull cannot drop further for 5 seconds.
Impact Mitigation: every projectile or missile that hits your armor or hull deals 20 less damage, before armor reduction.
Damage Control: engines and weapons repair faster the higher your combat readiness.
Field Modulation: the first overload each battle is cancelled and the ship vents, with +200% maneuverability fading over 5 seconds.
Target Analysis: every enemy ship starts with a weak spot on its outer edge: 1 to 4 armor cells (frigate to capital) with no armor.
Systems Expertise: using the ship system gives +50% top speed and maneuverability, fading over 5 seconds.
Point Defense: PD hits on missiles have a 10% chance to disarm the warhead.
Energy Weapon Mastery: energy weapons deal 25% more damage to armor.
Ballistic Mastery: while firing, weapons build up to perfect autofire accuracy and no recoil over 5 seconds.
Gunnery Implants: weapons with less range than your longest-range one gain 10% of its base range.
Ordnance Expertise: weapons cost 1 / 2 / 4 fewer ordnance points (small / medium / large).
Polarized Armor: after 3 seconds without taking damage, armor rebuilds to half of each cell's full value, only once per cell per battle.
Missile Specialization: guided missiles turn 50% faster; unguided ones slowly steer toward a target.
A LunaLib setting switches to the Original effects.

Officers
Optional, off by default. Turn it on in LunaLib and pick the cost: Peerless points, story points or credits.
An Officers button on the Character screen lists your officers and their Elite combat skills. Click one to make it Peerless; click again to undo it and get back what it cost.

Console Commands
PeerlessAddPoints [amount], PeerlessStatus, PeerlessUnlockAll, PeerlessRefund

Compatibility
Safe to add to a game in progress. Do not remove it from one.
Do not use it together with the first Peerless Skills mod.

AI use disclaimer
Some or all assets and code in this mod were created using AI tools:
Code: Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5)
Text (readme and this post): Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5)
Icons: Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5)

License
This mod is under the CC0 (Creative Commons Zero) License, allowing you to do whatever you want with the code, without giving any credit to anyone.

Version log
1.0.4
Polarized Armor: each armor cell now rebuilds only once per battle, at most half of its full armor. Before, a cell could rebuild again every time the ship went 3 seconds without damage.

1.0.3
Cleaner mod icon: even spacing around the stars.

1.0.2
Added the forum topic link for Version Checker.

1.0.1
Shorter text for the Original effects setting.

1.0.0
Peerless skills now show a gold diamond instead of the Elite stars on the Character screen.
Officers' Peerless skills now show in the skill tooltips of the game's own officer screens.
The Original effects setting now says where they come from: Starsector before 0.95 had Peerless skills.

0.2.0
Officers can get Peerless skills too (optional, off by default): LunaLib setting picks the cost, Peerless points, story points or credits; Officers button on the Character screen. Undoing an upgrade gives back what it cost.
Target Analysis: the weak spot is now 1 to 4 neighboring armor cells (frigate to capital) on the outer edge of every enemy ship.
Ordnance Expertise: the lower weapon costs now show and count in the refit screen.
Gunnery Implants: only ballistic and energy weapons in normal slots count; hidden and system weapons no longer set the longest range, so weapons no longer all gain a wrong amount.
Systems Expertise: the bonus now fades over 5 seconds instead of 3.
Impact Mitigation text reworded.

0.1.1
Peerless skill points are now a plain line under your level, no longer a box over the Executive Officers bar.
Save and Cancel moved under the Combat icon.
The skill tooltip no longer says "Needs Elite first".

0.1.0
First release: a Peerless level past Elite for your own fourteen combat skills, bought with Peerless skill points on the Second-in-Command Character screen (C).
